measure.sourceTitle: The Best 3 Star Hotels in Ho Chi Minh City | Expedia
measure.evidenceText: Expedia's exact Ho Chi Minh City 3-star trend table lists August $34. The evidence states that price-trend information excludes taxes and fees and is based on base rates for a nightly stay for 2 adults found in the last 7 days and averaged for commonly viewed 3-star properties in Ho Chi Minh City.
measure.referencePeriod: August 2026 monthly price trend; base rates averaged for a nightly stay for 2 adults found in the last 7 days (result crawled last week)
measure.searchQuery: site:expedia.com Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam 3-star hotels average nightly price trend 2 adults taxes fees
measure.reason: Accepted as strict source-feasibility evidence: exact city/class, numeric August trend, explicit two-adult basis, named USD display, seven-day reference window, and explicit tax exclusion are all present.
